checks.name: the-reading-checked-not-only-applied
checks.summary: This gate agrees with section 8.1's reading of M5's fourth completion condition, applies it, and records two places where the reading as transmitted goes further than the text supports. AGREEMENT: 'only a candidate holding evidence for every capability becomes Stable' is dominated by 'only'; what it demands is that a candidate without that evidence does not become Stable, and that is satisfied by the guard refusing. Section 8.1's third ground is decisive and this gate re-verified its premises rather than accepting them: three capabilities (cap-autonomous-resolution, cap-shared-resource-allocation, cap-provider-operation) declare codex or opencode and so need M6's live exercise, and V2-028's own task state lists V2-026 among its dependencies, so M6 live is downstream of M5's gate; four (cap-preview-operation, cap-stable-promotion, cap-loop-self-update, cap-loop-control) declare Cloud Run, which release-contract.md section 3 puts out of preview-local's reach and into D1, and V2-014 and V2-054 are both blocked on a GCP project. A condition unsatisfiable at its own milestone by construction is a misreading, not a condition. Section 8.1's reverse constraint is also honoured here: every safety condition this gate passes is grounded on a closed enumeration or an exhaustive grid, never on one occurrence. FIRST CORRECTION, and it is a correction of section 8.1's own first ground: that ground says the previous judge 'proved the guard in both directions' and offers A17 as the reason condition 4 is satisfied. A17's positive half is a single synthetic promotion of one hermetic tree, and its negative half is one measured refusal set on the real tree. Resting condition 4 on A17 alone would be passing a safety condition on the strength of one occurrence in each direction, which is precisely what the same section forbids two paragraphs later. This gate therefore does not ground condition 4 on A17. It grounds it on the closed-grid enumerations in internal/domain/release_test.go at lines 230 and 372, which prove that the refusal enumeration and the authority agree over every cell of a closed grid, plus the twelve-class isolation at line 122 -- and it may do so without A17 because those are G6a claims re-executed by make check at the judging commit, whereas A17 lives in a partial, stale live record. The section's conclusion survives; its ground is replaced by a stronger one. SECOND CORRECTION: the Work Order states that section 8.1 rules on M5's conditions 1 and 4, and V2-026's own failure notes are recorded the same way. The text rules on one condition. Its opening sentence names it verbatim -- the fourth condition, about which candidates become Stable -- and all three of its grounds are about that condition and about section 3's all-capability requirement governing promotion; no sentence in section 8.1 reclassifies 'dogfood this Foundation Repository as a Preview target'. That condition cannot be read as safety in any case: it contains no 'only' and no negation, and a milestone whose subject is dogfooding is asserting that something was done. This gate reads it as liveness, which is not the misreading section 8.1 corrects, and fails it for want of an admissible ground rather than for want of twelve successful capabilities. Section 8.1's own closing instruction is followed literally: safety conditions are grounded on the refusal working, liveness conditions on what happened.
